content:
Switched 3 companies in just 14 months of CA Articleship and now working at my 4th?

Sounds crazy, right? 🫠

I thought the exact same thing before writing this post. But every switch had a purpose, a story, and a massive learning curve. Here is how it unfolded:

 * 1st Stop: PwC (6 Months)
 Entered with zero experience, but left with a rock-solid foundation. Learned an immense amount in a short time, but had to move due to unavoidable circumstances.

 * 2nd Stop: Deloitte (6 Months)
 Gained deep exposure across diverse industries and sharpened my technical skill set. Left on a great note to pursue the next logical step: Industrial Training.

 * 3rd Stop: Haldiram Foods (2 Weeks)
 A brief pitstop! Worked here for two weeks, though the registration was never finalized. 😅

 * 4th & Final Stop: Sun Life ☀️
 Currently working in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC).

Looking back, non-linear paths can feel chaotic while you're on them, but every single transition brought unique exposure, adaptability, and resilience.

To anyone navigating unexpected turns in their articleship journey: trust the process, keep learning, and own your story! 🚀
